content:
The Update

CogmemAi just published five new Claude Code skills. Each one wires the same Smart Persistent Memory engine that scored 95.1% on LongMemEval (Apr 19, 2026) and 91% on LoCoMo (Apr 2, 2026) into a single, common developer workflow.

All five are open and discoverable on the Skills Marketplace, and the source lives in the public cogmemai-mcp repository.

The Five Skills

1. save-context

Capture the live conversation state so it survives compaction, session end, or model handoff. Fires on phrases like "save context", "checkpoint", "don’t lose this", or proactively when the context window is approaching its limit.

Use case: a long planning session just produced four decisions, two constraints, and a list of file paths. One extract_memories call saves all of them so the implementation phase resumes with the planning context intact.

2. remember-this

Persist a single stated preference, decision, or fact the moment the user says it. Triggers on "remember this", "don’t forget", "from now on", or any stable preference statement.

Use case: the user says "I always use Bun, never npm." The skill saves that as a global preference with importance 8 so it carries to every future session and every project.

3. session-start

Load top project memories at the start of every session before the assistant responds. The single highest-leverage continuity action.

Use case: the assistant opens a new session, calls get_project_context, surfaces three pending tasks and one active reminder from the prior session. Work resumes instantly, no re-discovery.

4. save-bugfix

After every resolved bug, save the symptom, root cause, fix, and why-it-works as a CogmemAi memory. Triggers on "got it", "that fixed it", "nailed it", or any verified fix.

Use case: the same Stripe webhook bug bites a teammate three months from now. They will not debug from scratch. They will find the fix in seconds.

5. search-before-debugging

The partner skill. Before debugging any new bug, error, or unexpected behavior, search CogmemAi for an existing fix from this or any past session.

Use case: a flaky test starts failing. Instead of opening the file, the assistant runs recall_memories with the error string. If a past session fixed the same thing, the answer arrives in 30 seconds. If not, the assistant debugs from scratch and the next person benefits.

Why This Matters

Every team wastes hours re-debugging problems someone already solved. The fix lives in someone’s head, or buried in Slack, or attached to an old ticket nobody can find. Smart Persistent Memory eliminates that loss. CogmemAi saves every fix as a searchable memory and surfaces it the next time the symptom appears.

At a 95.1% LongMemEval score, the memory layer is accurate enough to be trusted in production. At the free-tier price, every team can adopt it.

How To Install

npm install -g cogmemai-mcp
npx cogmemai-mcp setup

The setup wizard registers the CogmemAi MCP server with Claude Code, writes the hooks for autonomous memory capture, and prompts for your free API key. Sixty seconds from install to first memory saved.

Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Continue users follow the same install command and point their MCP config at cogmemai-mcp. Per-editor guides at hifriendbot.com/developer.

Star The Repository

If the skills are useful, star the cogmemai-mcp repository. Stars feed the Skills Marketplace ranker so more developers find these workflows when they search for "memory", "save context", or "remember this".

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Claude Code skill?

A Claude Code skill is a small markdown file with frontmatter that teaches an Ai agent when and how to use a tool or workflow. Skills live in a public repository, get indexed automatically by the Skills Marketplace, and the agent invokes them based on natural language triggers in the conversation.

How do the new CogmemAi skills work?

Each skill describes a single common memory workflow (save context, remember this, session start, save bugfix, search before debugging) and tells the agent which CogmemAi MCP tool to call, what parameters to pass, and which trigger phrases activate the skill. The Ai assistant invokes the right skill automatically as the conversation unfolds.

Where can I find the skill source?

All five skills live in the public cogmemai-mcp/skill/ directory. Browse them, fork them, suggest improvements.

How do I add memory to Claude Code?

Install the CogmemAi MCP server with npm install -g cogmemai-mcp, then run npx cogmemai-mcp setup. Free tier available.

What is the best Ai memory benchmark score?

CogmemAi holds the top published score on LongMemEval at 95.1%, measured April 19, 2026. On LoCoMo, CogmemAi scored 91% on April 2, 2026, above the 87.9% human baseline.

Is CogmemAi free?

Yes. The free tier includes 500 memories and 500 extractions per month across 5 projects. No credit card required.

Try The Skills

Get your free API key, install the MCP server, and the five new skills are live in your Claude Code session automatically. No additional configuration needed.

CogmemAi is the Smart Persistent Memory layer for Ai agents. 95.1% on LongMemEval (April 19, 2026). 91% on LoCoMo (April 2, 2026). Available as MCP server, REST API, and direct API. Built by HiFriendbot.
